purpose: 12-question A-F diagnostic that classifies which carbon/climate obligations bind a firm (CBAM authorised-declarant duty, EU Taxonomy alignment, EU Green Bond conformance, climate stress) and routes to the right carbon-compliance chain. Separates in-force CBAM definitive liability (since 1 Jan 2026) from prepare-ahead items (first declaration 30 Sep 2027, downstream scope 1 Jan 2028).
